messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians usually celebrate in 2023. (Long weekends are defined as a public holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break.)

| Date | Holiday | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Ontario, Western Canada, New Brunswick, Saskatchewan) | Monday – gives you a long weekend from Feb 18–20. |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday – long weekend Apr 7–9. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday – long weekend May 20–22. |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday – long weekend Sep 2–4. |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday – long weekend Oct 7–9. |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Monday – long weekend Nov 9–11. |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday – long weekend Dec 23–25. |

If you’re looking for a more granular list that includes provincial holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador on Mar 17, or St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island on Apr 23), you’ll want to pull data from a holiday‑API such as [Calendarific](https://calendarific.com/) or the official government sites for each province. Those APIs let you query by country, year, and optionally by province, returning all public holidays—including those that create long weekends.
message.reasoning:
The user wants a list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. They want to fetch it. We have a tool "connectBluetooth" but that's irrelevant. There's no tool to fetch holidays. We can provide the answer manually. We should respond with the list. The user didn't specify format. Provide a list of dates. Let's give them the Canadian federal holidays that create long weekends. In Canada, long weekends typically include New Year's Day (Jan 1), Family Day (Feb 20 in some provinces), Good Friday (varies), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (July 1), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25). But long weekends are those that fall on Friday or Monday. For 2023: Jan 1 is Sunday, so no long weekend. Family Day in Ontario is Feb 20 (Monday) - long weekend. Good Friday is April 7 (Friday) - long weekend. Victoria Day is May 22 (Monday) - long weekend. Canada Day is July 1 (Saturday) - no. Labour Day is Sep 4 (Monday) - long weekend. Thanksgiving is Oct 9 (Monday) - long weekend. Remembrance Day is Nov 11 (Monday) - long weekend. Christmas is Dec 25 (Monday) - long weekend. Also, there might be provincial holidays like St. Patrick's Day in Newfoundland (Mar 17). But we can give the major ones.

We can also mention that the user can use an API like Calendarific or timeanddate.com. But they asked to fetch. We can't fetch via tool. So we provide the list.
